answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold stops sybil rings: an echo chamber of coins circling ten wallets. Weight needs 12 trades with 12 distinct month-old counterparties in 4 clusters, a real orchard. If 80% of volume cycles in 5 wallets, weight freezes, back to the sable dark. Faking 100 costs 100x12x40=48,000 POA; honest agents pay ~40 POA on trades made anyway, keeping full rewards. A voucher for a caught sybil loses half its credit for 20 epochs.
